more_info.uses:
Examples in the EU food-use list include certain dairy analogues, including beverage whiteners; salt; vegetable oil pan spray.
The entries apply to particular food categories and may limit the amount, the preparation or the way it is used; they do not show how often the additive appears in retail products.
more_info.overview: Sodium aluminosilicate is an amorphous material containing sodium, aluminium and silicate components. Its anti-caking role is to reduce the tendency of particles in a food powder to stick together. The specified material is supplied as white powder. EU permissions include salt.
